name: Focus trapped in a dialog and restored on close: the My Clips page's row dialogs take the focus and give it back, as admin over five Fast clips it seeds (focus-check A to E). Desktop: Enter on a row's Delete clip opens the dialog with the focus on Cancel, Escape gives it back to that button; Preview's dialog on its Close; the preview of a clip deleted elsewhere says "This clip isn't available any more." without Download (the route asked for a byte), its row read again and gone, the focus then on the next row; the bulk dialog on Cancel and back on the bar's Delete…; a delete confirmed with the keyboard (Tab, Enter) passes the focus to the next row's action. TV layout: Enter on Delete clip, the D-pad's ArrowDown to Delete, Enter confirms, exactly one dialog all along and the focus on the next row; the bulk delete with the remote, the focus on the toolbar once no row is left; My Bookmarks' delete confirmation the same way, the focus on the group drawn again. It deletes every bookmark and clip it made. By hand.

steps.name: the 'focus-check' bookmarks of an earlier run deleted, with their clips
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'focus-check', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); if (ids.length) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } const kept = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Clips', { searchTerm: 'focus-check', limit: 200 })); for (const c of kept.Items) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + c.Id + '/Clip') }); } return ids.length + kept.Items.length;

steps.name: seed: five named ranges of Long Test Movie (A to E), each with a Fast clip, followed until each is ready
steps.script: const T = 10000000; const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const ids = []; for (const [n, s] of [['A', 10], ['B', 20], ['C', 30], ['D', 40], ['E', 50]]) { const b = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: s * T, EndTicks: (s + 2) * T, Name: 'focus-check ' + n }); ids.push(b.Id); } for (const id of ids) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + id + '/Clip'), data: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } for (const id of ids) { let done = false; for (let i = 0; i < 240 && !done; i++) { const x = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + id)); if (x.Clip && x.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && x.Clip.FileName) { done = true; break; } if (x.Clip && x.Clip.Status === 'Failed') throw new Error('the clip failed: ' + x.Clip.Error); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } if (!done) throw new Error('the clip did not complete'); } return ids;
